guideFormat: guide: first paragraph = summary; lines '1. ...' = steps; [n] = source n in sources.json

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

missable.note: Only one trophy is called possibly missable (Positive Mental Attitude) [7][9][27].

disputes.topic: How many trophies are hidden on PSN
sides: 28 of 55 are hidden: Output Lag and GameTrek name the same 28 [9][22], as do CULTR and Leonida Verse [39][44].
KeenGamer marks only 2 as hidden and Game-Checklists 5 [7][19].
disputes.call: 28. Exophase's own page flags exactly those 28 as secret [1]; the low counts look like lists of the vaguely worded ones.

sides: 4/10, long rather than hard [7][19][2].
disputes.call: Closer to 4/10: three guides agree and none of the 55 needs a difficulty setting [7].

trophies.guide:
The platinum unlocks once the other 54 trophies are earned; plan on one playthrough of roughly 200 hours, the figure first floated before launch [7][9][27][37].
1. Play the story once: there are no difficulty settings, no New Game+ and no mission replay [2][7].
2. Keep several manual saves; the game offers 15 manual slots plus an autosave [42][2].
3. Never enter a cheat on the save you are using: cheats switch off trophies and saving for that session [9][35].
4. There are no online trophies, so everything is done in single-player [7][9][22].
5. Leave A Long Road for last; the 100% checklist covers most of the activity trophies on the way [7].
6. For the record: the count of 55 leaked through dataminers ten days before launch, and the full list went public on 2026-11-18 [36][43][45].

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide:
Unlocks by finishing Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1 after the Prologue [17][2].
1. Play through the Prologue as Lucia; Gone Fishing follows as Chapter 1's opening mission [17][29].
2. Finish it and the trophy pops; nothing optional is needed [2].

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide:
Awarded for Chapter 1, which GTABase ends with Discharge Time; the trophy may only show once Chapter 2 starts [17][19].
1. Before Tourist Trap, do the balcony meditation and anything else you want at Jason's house: that mission costs you the house [29][25].
2. Finish Discharge Time, the last Chapter 1 mission [17].
3. If nothing pops, play the first Chapter 2 mission, What's in the Bag? [2][15].

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide:
Comes with the end of Chapter 2 (Checking Out in GTABase's list); it shows during the first Chapter 3 mission [17][2].
1. Raise the $15,000 that Prepare for Vice City asks for [17].
2. Finish Checking Out, then start Welcome to Vice City; the trophy appears there [17][2][29].

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide:
Chapter 3 closes with The Cartel Heist; the trophy lands as Chapter 4 opens [17][2].
1. Complete The Cartel Heist [17].
2. Carry on into Ocean Beach and Another Life: Dork saw it pop during Another Life, PowerPyx after it [29][2].

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide:
Chapter 4 ends with Starting From Zero; like the other chapter trophies it may wait for the next chapter to begin [17][27].
1. Finish Starting From Zero, the Chapter 4 finale [17][29].
2. If it has not appeared, start Bird in the Hand, the first Chapter 5 mission [17][27].

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

missable.note: Story progress; free roam continues afterwards [15][2].

disputes.topic: Which mission is the final one
sides: PowerPyx ties this gold to Starting From Zero [2].
GTABase and Dork list Starting From Zero as the end of Chapter 4 and The End of the Road as the last Chapter 5 mission [17][40][29].
disputes.call: The End of the Road. PowerPyx's own Snow Storm entry sits in Chapter 5, after Starting From Zero [2].

trophies.guide:
The gold for finishing the story; the final mission is The End of the Road, the last entry of Chapter 5 [17][40].
1. Save in a new slot before Chapter 5 and again before the last mission; several endings are reported but not yet verified [29][34].
2. Finish The End of the Road [17][29].
3. Free roam carries on afterwards, so side content and the 100% checklist stay open [15][2].

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide:
A Chapter 2 main mission: Breakfast Run is entry 42 in GTABase's list, a robbery of three Port Gellhorn businesses in Dork's walkthrough [17][29].
1. Progress Chapter 2 until Breakfast Run is offered [17].
2. Complete it; the trophy pops at the end [2].

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide:
The Cartel Heist is Chapter 3's finale [17][2].
1. Do the set-up missions Company Property and Hidden Charges well: Dork says they decide how long the vault takes, so aim to take down three towers [29].
2. Complete The Cartel Heist [17].

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide:
Child's Play is a Chapter 4 main mission, entry 101 in GTABase's list [17][2].
1. Play Chapter 4 until Child's Play [17][29].
2. Complete it [2].

trophies.name: DWNFALL

sides: Straight after Child's Play [17].
Later, after Heist Plans in Place and just before VCIA Takedown [29].
disputes.call: It does not matter for the trophy: both put it inside Chapter 4 before VCIA Takedown [17][29].

trophies.guide:
Headliners is a Chapter 4 main mission [17][2].
1. Progress Chapter 4; Headliners comes before the airport heist [17][29].
2. Complete it [2].

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide:
VCIA Takedown is Chapter 4's airport heist; it is a different trophy from the free-roam plane theft, Catch Me If You Can [17][29].
1. Finish the heist set-ups up to Heist Plans in Place [17].
2. Complete VCIA Takedown [17][2].

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide:
Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 main mission; Chapter 5 has no separate completion trophy [17][15][7].
1. Play Chapter 5 past Bird in the Hand, Taking Liberties, VC Baby and Doggie Bag [17].
2. Complete Operation Savage Glory [17][2].

trophies.name: A Long Road

missable.note: GTABase says nothing on the 100% list is missable, as it can be finished in free roam; some optional story-time tasks do close [16].

trophies.guide:
The biggest trophy: the 100% checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion [16][9].
1. Know the weighting: story 50%, tasks 27%, exploration and activities 20%, discovery 3% [16].
2. Tasks include all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 Payday Loans and 8 vaults, plus fencing targets such as $250k of marked bills [16][7].
3. Activities include all 42 shooting golds, all 42 drone trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges and 30 of 40 races [16][7].
4. Collections include 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, 100 WAiNK locations and 33 underwater finds; discovery needs 200 of 277 vehicles, 50 of 66 weapons and 100 of 255 animals [16].
5. The thresholds are about 60% of everything in the game, so you never need every last item [2].

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide:
Any 250 of the 397 stunts count; the 100% list wants 300, so you will pass this on the way [16][7].
1. Four kinds count: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps [16].
2. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to stack them [2][27][19].
3. A stunt's optional challenge is not needed for it to count [2].
4. Check progress in Progress > Activities > Stunts; PowerPyx notes R3 shows it by region [16][2].

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.

count.basis: 9 types per Output Lag and KeenGamer [10][7].

trophies.guide:
Try nine activity types once each; winning is not required [10][7].
1. The nine: fishing, pool, hunting, basketball, golf, a video game, a shooting range challenge, a race (a race challenge or drone race also works) and a stunt [10].
2. Progress shows under Progress > Activities [2][15].
3. Fishing for Cal and the console at Jason's house cover two of them in Chapter 1 [12][10].

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

count.basis: 42 golds per KeenGamer, Output Lag and GameTrek [7][10][23].

sides: 2 ranges, Griffin and Rodgers Ranch, with 12 challenges between them [10][23][16].
disputes.call: 2 ranges. The 12 is the challenge count: 6 challenges with 3 medals at Griffin and 6 with 4 at Rodgers add up to the 42 golds [10][3].

trophies.guide:
Gold every challenge at both shooting ranges: 42 golds in all, often called the hardest single trophy [10][16][19].
1. Ranges: Griffin Shooting Range in north-west Vice City (18 golds) and Rodgers Ranch north-east of Port Gellhorn (24 golds) [10][23].
2. Buy the $5 waiver from the clerk before your first try [10][16].
3. Play Griffin's timed courses as Lucia, and avoid misses at Rodgers, where a multiplier sets the score [10].
4. Use Combat Focus (L3+R3), aim for heads and leave the sniper courses until last [23].
5. Track it under Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges; the sessions also raise your Focus for Gunslinger [16][10].

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

count.basis: 14 locations per Output Lag and KeenGamer [10][7].

trophies.guide:
Win one drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations; each holds three races, 42 in all [10][7].
1. Find them under Map > Activities > Top Fun Drones [10][16].
2. Beat par on a venue's first two races to open its third [10].
3. One win per location is enough for the trophy, but 100% wants all 42 [16].
4. PowerPyx's checklist says the third race of a venue only has to be finished, not won [3].
trophies.unconfirmed: No page we could read lists the 14 venues; the one that does refused our request.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide:
Win 20 of the 40 races; 100% asks for 30 [10][7].
1. Races are blue icons that show up within about 100 m; filter them under Map > Activities > Racing [10].
2. Yago's street races open in Chapter 3 [10].
3. Winning the same race twice counts once [15][19].
4. Rival cars catch up when you lead, so do not ease off [10].

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide:
Cal texts you after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui and asks for a photo of a big Stoplight Parrotfish [12][19].
1. Pick up the free rod at the jetty behind Jason's house; his boat carries rods too, and the starter lure is fine [12].
2. Set Cal's Stoplight Parrotfish spot, a purple circle on the water, as your destination; PowerPyx puts it west of Key Lento [12][2].
3. Inside the circle, catch a Stoplight Parrotfish over 2 lb, releasing anything smaller [12].
4. Choose Take Photo for Cal to win [12].

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

missable.note: The home console is off-limits for part of Chapter 2 only [16].

disputes.topic: Where the four games can be played
sides: All on the console at Jason's house or in Bang For Your Buck cabinets [10].
Three on the home TV; Bang For Your Buck only in arcades [2], one cabinet in Key Lento [19].
disputes.call: Use the home TV: both sides agree three games are there [2][10].

trophies.guide:
Play one of the four video games through to its end [7][2].
1. Games unlock in Chapter 1 on the console at Jason's house [10].
2. PowerPyx names the three home games Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind [2].
3. Merely starting a game does not count: reach its ending [2].
4. The home console is unavailable for part of Chapter 2, so do it early or later [16].

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.

sides: A Chapter 3 call or text to Lucia with a Belville address [2][15].
Finishing Mami Knows Best and Car Service [33].
disputes.call: Both are Chapter 3; play those missions and wait for Andy's message.

trophies.guide:
Andy's strand is Lucia only and five missions long; it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks [9][19][27].
1. In Chapter 3 Andy contacts Lucia with an address in Belville [2][15].
2. Work through his missions; the last one, Puff Puff Pass, gives the trophy [2][5].
3. If you skip it, it waits for you after the story [15][32].

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

missable.note: Kenton leaves after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2 to 3 [2][32].

disputes.topic: How many shipwrecks Kenton's strand has
sides: Output Lag confirms only 4 by name and calls 7 unconfirmed [14].
disputes.call: Plan for 7 and let the trophy decide; the 100% list wants all 33 underwater finds anyway [16][14].

trophies.guide:
Kenton Rees runs Island Dreams Boat Charters in Key Lento; his treasure hunts start after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams [14].
1. Look for his green KR icon [32][2].
2. Dive sites are purple chest markers: suit up from the boat deck and use the metal detector from the weapon wheel, whose light turns from red to green as you close in [14].
3. Dig buried chests with the Pull Out Chest prompt; watch your oxygen and look out for sharks [14].
4. Kenton drops out after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again in Chapters 2 to 3; calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 is said to speed this up [2][32].
5. Bank your cash after selling finds to him, since carried money is lost if you die or are busted [14].

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide:
Billy's five-mission strand starts at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County after Coffee Break in Chapter 2; it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks [15][2][27].
1. Go to the mud club once Coffee Break is done [15][33].
2. Missions run Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes [5][33].
3. Mall Rats is a Chapter 3 job at Ocean Beach, so the strand stretches over two chapters [33].
4. Hometown Heroes, the last one, gives the trophy [5].

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

missable.lastChance: Before Race Against Yago expires in Chapter 3
missable.note: Yago's strand counts and his race is time-limited [9][20]; PowerPyx says missable quests do not count [5]. Other strands stay open after the story [15][32].

disputes.topic: Does the time-limited Race Against Yago matter
sides: Yago's strand counts and his race can expire, so it is a risk [27][9][20].
Quests that can be missed do not count toward the eight [5].
disputes.call: Do it when it appears in Chapter 3: it costs nothing and settles the question.

trophies.guide:
Finish eight stranger strands; only some characters count, and guides have named just four of them so far [19][2].
1. Counting: Kirk (flyer at Skeeter's bar in Hamlet, Chapter 1), Kyle (Chapter 2), Yago (Chapter 3, after Dealer's Choice) and Pilot Pete (Chapter 4, after Pool Day) [33][5].
2. Not counting: Andy, Billy and Tyrone, and also Moses, Yasmani, Eddie and Shirley [27][19][18].
3. Two of Kirk's missions are night only and Mr. Mangrove is for Lucia; Pilot Pete's are Jason only [5].
4. For the other four, watch the trophy's progress number after each strand's last mission [5][15].
5. GTABase lists 35 stranger missions so far [18].

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide:
Randy's Wish List asks for 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City, marked with a green RK icon [15][2][32].
1. It opens with the Chapter 3 job that gives you the Key Cloner (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy in GTABase's list) [2][17].
2. Scan cars with WAiNK to see whether they are on the list [32].
3. Hotel driveways in Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are good places to look [32].
4. Deliver them undamaged: condition sets the pay [32].
5. The list is under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List [32].

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

disputes.topic: Is all of Tyrone's strand Jason only
sides: Yes, the whole strand [27][15].
Only the last mission [33].
disputes.call: Play it as Jason throughout; that satisfies both.

trophies.guide:
Tyrone's strand is for Jason; it opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty and does not count toward Strangers & Freaks [9][15][27].
1. After Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers appear on synthetic drug labs around Vice City [15][2].
2. Destroy enough labs to unlock Tyrone's final job [15][2].
3. Complete that job for the trophy; each lab also counts for 100% [2][32].

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

count.basis: 18 per KeenGamer and Game-Checklists [7][19]; LibertyCity counts 10 physical spots that the menu tallies as 18 sessions [25].

missable.note: Jason's balcony session is gone after Chapter 1 [25][13].

disputes.topic: Is the Chapter 1 balcony session needed?
sides: Yes: skip it and the trophy is lost for good [20].
Not confirmed either way [7][13][27].
disputes.call: Treat it as required: it takes a minute and is the list's only possible missable [7][9].

trophies.guide:
Unlocks in Chapter 1; the list's only possible missable [25][7][9].
1. After Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept: the balcony session may not return after Chapter 1 [25][9].
2. Spots show as purple icons; the map filter is Meditate Around Leonida [9][25].
3. Spots: Jason's balcony, the sandbar west of Capri, Buckskin Swamp dock, Camp Moonflower, Manifest Canyon, opposite Lawton Paper Mill, a cliffside in Mount Kalaga NP, a waterfall north-west of Tallaloko and the shoreline east of Waning Sands [25].
4. Meditating with your partner is reported to count twice; character switching opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 [7][25].
5. The last spot, Mount Kalaga's summit, appears only after all the others are done [25][19].
6. Check the tally in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; 100% needs 15 of 18 [25][16].

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

sides: One unique animal, but which one is unconfirmed [27][9].
Finishing all 15 Target Decks covers it [19][2].
disputes.call: Work through the Target Decks in order; 100% wants all 15 anyway [16].

trophies.guide:
Bret's hunting strand is for Jason; it starts with a text after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 [9][15][2].
1. Bret's message opens Veteran Hunted in Lummox County [15][2].
2. He hands over the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle, which you can also take from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker [2][32].
3. Target Decks appear as purple icons; there are 15 [15][2].
4. A clean head or heart shot pays better but is not required [9][15].

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide:
Finish 3 of the 18 card sets (480 cards: 10 sports sets and 8 entertainment sets); 100% wants 15 sets [24][16].
1. Go for the small sets: Backyard Wrestling has 12 cards and Delights Dancers 18, while most hold 24 or more [24].
2. Or start with the Vice City team sets, whose cards cluster in the city [24].
3. Cards sit in fixed places: shelves, wall mounts, yellow phone boxes and garage tool boxes [24].
4. Bronze, silver and gold variants count as separate cards, and selling one at a pawn shop keeps it in your set [24].
5. A few cards are behind story moments or keypads, so some sets fill only later [38].

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide:
WAiNK is the phone camera: photographing a point of interest counts as a scan, and any mix of 100 works [21].
1. Scan with Up on the d-pad, then R1 [2].
2. Sets include 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags and others [21].
3. Fit the whole structure in the frame or it may not register [21].
4. Vice Beach and Washington Beach have dense clusters [21].
5. Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations shows the count [21][16].

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide:
Complete 50 of the 80 challenges (8 categories of 10); 100% needs 70 [16][9].
1. Open Progress > Challenges to see each category [16][9].
2. Hovering over a challenge shows a Completed tick once done [2].
3. Pick the categories you are closest to finishing: the official description asks only for a total of 50 [1].

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

missable.note: Game-Checklists advises finishing partner trophies before the final mission in case the ending limits who you can play [20]; free roam is said to stay open [15].

trophies.guide:
With your partner along, reach four stars and get clear of the heat zone [9][27].
1. Possible from Coffee Break in Chapter 2 [15][2].
2. Call your partner first by holding right on the d-pad, then Triangle [15][2].
3. Leaving the flashing search area is not enough: you must get out of the red heat zone [9][27].
4. Vault robberies start at four stars, so it often comes with them, and it pops during That's Where The Money Is… [9][2].
5. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a suggested escape [2][15][19].

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

missable.note: Same partner precaution as Hot Together [20].

trophies.guide:
Rob three shops in a row with your partner while you are still wanted [9][27].
1. Possible once your partner is free to join you after Chapter 2 [19][2].
2. If the stars fade to red heat between shops, the chain resets [9][27].
3. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City are close together and open with Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 [2][15].
4. Bring armor, sticky bombs and healing [15][2].
5. The trophy can lag about 30 seconds; rob a fourth shop if it still has not popped [9][2].

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide:
A vehicle counts as discovered once you scan it with WAiNK; you do not need to drive it [16][9].
1. Scan passing traffic as you play; boats and aircraft count too [16][2].
2. Progress > Vehicles shows the tally [16].
3. 100% asks for 200 of the 277 base models, so this comes long before that [16].

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide:
Kill five enemies inside one Combat Focus window [9][27].
1. Combat Focus is L3+R3 while aiming [9][27].
2. Only gang criminals are reported to count, not police, soldiers or civilians [28][19].
3. Fill the Focus meter first: shooting range sessions raise it, and eating, drinking or showering at home refills it [10][2].
4. Take an assault rifle to a group of gang guards, for example at an illegal operation [9][8].

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

sides: Any departing aircraft [7].
Only a passenger jet docked at a boarding bridge; planes parked on the airfield do not [9][27][2].
disputes.call: Take a docked jet at a bridge: it satisfies both readings.

trophies.guide:
Steal a passenger jet from a boarding bridge at the Vice City airport and fly it away [9][2].
1. Save first [9].
2. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest; climb the bridge stairs to board [19][2].
3. Taxi to the runway and take off [2].
4. Fly roughly 1 km away and the trophy pops [9][27].

trophies.name: Challenging Tank

disputes.topic: What you must do in the tank
sides: Steal a Rhino and use it in a fight [7].
Getting in is enough [9].
disputes.call: Get in and keep fighting until it pops, as PowerPyx describes [2].

trophies.guide:
The Rhinos are tanks at Mile Zero Air Station, a military base on the south-west island [2][15][27].
1. Save before you go in [9].
2. The tanks are on the south side of the base [2][9].
3. Get in through the gate or the stunt jump near the south-east entrance [2].
4. Climb into a tank and fight off the soldiers until the trophy appears [2].

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide:
Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun, the tool for a silent break-in [27][9].
1. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the store guides suggest [9][19][15].
2. Open the locked back door with the Snap Gun; kicking it sets off the alarm [27][9].
3. Find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe [27][9].
4. PowerPyx also wipes the security footage and disables the alarm [2].
5. Leave without being seen [27].

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide:
Rob five of the eight bank vaults; 100% wants all eight [27][7].
1. Vaults open with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… [7][27].
2. Tail a security van to its bank and get in while the vault is open [27][9].
3. Take your partner: one person cannot carry the whole haul [27].
4. Vaults always bring four stars; a fast bike and a vehicle swap help you escape [15][2].
5. After two Payday Loans jobs, Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 [2][32].

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide:
Rob an armored truck and get away; an escaped vault robbery is reported to count as well [27][2].
1. Buy sticky bombs in the back of Yasmani's shop once his jobs are done [2][32].
2. Box a truck in and stick a bomb on its rear doors [15][2].
3. Grab the cash and run [15].
4. It pops once you leave the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray [9][27].

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide:
Clear the fog from every segment of the map; missions alone will not reveal all of it [26].
1. Entering a segment for a moment clears its fog [26].
2. GamerFuzion, citing PowerPyx, recommends a double-decker crop duster: it carries no tracker, so no jets chase you, and it has fuel to spare [26].
3. This is possible from Chapter 1 [26].
4. Expect gaps even after many hours of normal play, so plan a dedicated sweep [26].
trophies.unconfirmed: No source we read says how many map segments there are.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide:
Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gang groups; 39 operations exist in all [8][27].
1. The groups: Kingfishers, Kolts & Associates, M7, La Polilla Negra, Final Chapter, San4San, PTT Youngin$, Guardia Brothers and Other Criminals [8][6].
2. Sites show under Map > Robberies > Illegal Operations once you have been to the area; Progress > Gangs keeps the score [8][6].
3. An operation counts only when you take every key valuable, the safe included [8].
4. Safe codes change each time; find them on site or on knocked-out guards [8].
5. Jobs done before the end-of-Chapter-1 money wipe still count, but the Ultimate Edition bonus site does not [8][6].

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

sides: Next to the bar [2].
At the beach-side rail [30].
disputes.call: Try the rail with the view first, then the bar; both are on the same rooftop [30][2].

trophies.guide:
Have a cocktail at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach; several guides still call the exact trigger unconfirmed [2][30][7].
1. Head to Ocean Beach on the east side of the map [2][30].
2. A poolside door behind the bar leads to a lift up to the roof [30].
3. Buy a cocktail from the barmaid; PowerPyx names an Apple Martini [30][2].
4. Drink it while looking out over the beach [30].

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide:
Drive a car out of a showroom through its window; only PowerPyx names the exact car, so treat the details as one source's account [2][19][7].
1. Get the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 Randy job first [2][17].
2. In the south Vice City showroom, take the blue Banshee: PowerPyx says no other car counts [2].
3. Drive it straight out through the front window [2][19].
4. Keep going; the trophy pops a little way off [2].

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

missable.note: Missed items return when the robbery respawns [2][15].

sides: The description names Kolt & Associates' alley [1][31].
Guides send you to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn [2][19][27].
disputes.call: Kingpin Bowling. KeenGamer lists Kolts & Associates as one of the nine gangs [8], so we read Kingpin as their alley; that link is our inference.

trophies.guide:
Rob the Kingpin Bowling operation in Port Gellhorn, an optional Chapter 2 job called Hit Kingpin Bowling [17][2].
1. Take the watch from the south-east office [2][29].
2. Take the unique Gutterball shotgun [2].
3. Blow the hallway safe with sticky bombs [2].
4. Escape the police; Dork had two stars [29][2].
5. You do not need all three in one visit [15].

trophies.name: Personal Best

missable.note: Needs both characters; Game-Checklists advises doing it before the final mission [20].

trophies.guide:
Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia [2][27][7].
1. Possible once your partner can join you after Coffee Break [19][2].
2. Train together at a fitness club: the partner trains passively alongside you [2][27].
3. Check both meters under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia [2].

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide:
Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile; the trophy list shows the progress [7][9][2].
1. It mostly comes from robberies and fights in normal play [9][2].
2. Running people over speeds it up [2].
3. Careful: the Psycho and Irredeemable profiles make police shoot on sight, and Irredeemable cannot be undone [2][15][27].

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

missable.note: No source we read knows the trigger [7][27][19]; PowerPyx suspects a repeat of the Prologue's Payday Loans robbery [2].

trophies.guide:
Nobody has confirmed what unlocks this yet [7][27][28].
1. PowerPyx's lead: rob the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba, where the Prologue robbery happens, a second time [2].
2. Keep a save from before you try, and check back here as guides update [2].

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

missable.note: Reported as a random free-roam event [2].

sides: A random UFO event near Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 2 AM [2].
Leads for a Crosstown stairwell room with a six-digit code, or a keypad at the Abandoned Site north-east of Cottonmouth Lake [9].
disputes.call: Try PowerPyx's route first, as the only full method; all three remain unconfirmed [7][27].

trophies.guide:
A UFO encounter by PowerPyx's account; other guides list it as unconfirmed [2][7][27].
1. Go alone, after 2 AM, to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County [2].
2. Look for a car with flashing lights; it does not always spawn [2].
3. Follow the path into the woods to the UFO and agree to help the woman there [2].
4. Take her back to her car [2].

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

sides: Kick 10 pedestrians from a bike within 60 seconds [2].
Knock people over with a melee drive-by, count unstated [19]; the trigger is unconfirmed [7][27].
disputes.call: Follow PowerPyx's 10-in-60 on a bike: it meets the other reading too.

trophies.guide:
Knock pedestrians down with melee attacks from a moving bike; PowerPyx gives the only exact count [2][19].
1. Get on any bike [2].
2. Ride through a crowded area and kick walkers with Square [2].
3. Aim for ten within 60 seconds [2].

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide:
Launder a running total of $250,000 in marked bills through fences [9][19].
1. The Chapter 3 mission Credit Check gives the Dye Pack Jammer, which lets you keep marked bills [16][2].
2. Marked bills come from bank and Payday Loans jobs [9][27].
3. Yasmani pays the best rate [15][2][19].
4. Vaults pay up to $205,000 each once That's Where The Money Is… is done [2][15].

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide:
Spending adds up across every shop until it reaches $100,000 [9].
1. Weapons, car modifications and tattoos burn money fastest [2][15][19].
2. PowerPyx counts 14 mod shops, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores and 11 tattoo studios among others [2].

trophies.name: Little Boxes

count.basis: 8 purchasable garages per Output Lag and PowerPyx [9][4].

missable.note: Buyable any time after Daily Driver [9].

trophies.guide:
Buy the eight purchasable garages, about $160,000 together; story garages do not count [9][4].
1. The Vice City Real Estate app opens after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver [11][9].
2. PowerPyx's prices run from $4,000 (Mitchell Auto Center) to $40,000 (Atlantic Court) [4].
3. Output Lag calls exact prices unconfirmed, so check them in the app [11].

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide:
Register ten stolen cars through the Scooter Bros app, which Moses installs in Chapter 2 [11][19].
1. Do Lucia's Chapter 2 mission for Moses at Watkins Auto Parts in Port Gellhorn [11].
2. Steal a car without a tracker, respray it, then choose Register [11].
3. The first registration is free; later ones cost several times the car's sale value, so pick cheap cars and bikes [11][2].
4. Each registered car needs a garage space [11][9].
5. From Chapter 3, Pay 'n' Spray can register cars that have a standard tracker [11].
